name: Coding for Science Camp
what_you_do: A free five-day summer camp where you learn Python from Argonne computer scientists. You do hands-on team activities and see how coding helps solve science problems. No coding experience needed.
who_can_apply: Rising high school sophomores or juniors who are new to coding. You must attend all five days and get yourself to Argonne.
deadline_text: The 2026 application is closed. Last cycle, applications were due by mid-April and students heard back in early May.
how_to_apply: Submit an application on the camp page when it opens. Only 30 students are picked.
notes: Very popular, with only 30 spots. Questions: kmoran@anl.gov. Argonne also runs Big Data Camp for juniors and seniors who already code.
